 Date :- 15 January 2024
 P.C. :-
 1.
Ms. Sneha Jamboli, learned counsel states that she has  instructions to appear for the Respondent No.2 who is the first  informant.
She seeks adjournment.

Therefore, at her instance,
 today I am adjourning the matter.
However, I have heard the  parties for consideration of ad-interim relief.

2. The Applicant is seeking anticipatory bail in connection  with C.R.No. 935 of 2023 registered with Dharavi Police Station,
 Mumbai, on 14.12.2023, under Sections 376, 417, 323, 504 and 506 of the Indian Penal Code.

sentences.text: The first informant came in contact with the present  applicant through a social networking site.
The informant was  already married, but her husband had left her.
She was residing  with her two children aged 14 years and 12 years.
The informant  came in contact with the present applicant in the year 2020.
Slowly their acquaintance developed into a love affair.
It is her  case that, at the first instance, the applicant established physical  relations on the promise of marriage.
Thereafter the physical  relations continued for a long time.
In between she came to know  that the applicant was married.
He represented to her that he was  giving divorce to her wife.
On this assurance she continued  physical relations from 2020 to November 2023.

Ultimately, the  applicant did not marry her and, therefore, she lodged this F.I.R.
 4.
Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that the  narration in the F.I.R. itself shows that it was purely a consensual  relationship.
The informant was married and the F.I.R. mentions  that she came to know that the applicant was married.
Even  thereafter their physical relations continued.
Therefore, there was  no question of misconception of facts.

sentences.text: Considering these submissions, the applicant can be  protected by ad-interim relief.
6. Hence, the following order.
ORDER i) Issue notice to the Respondent No.2.

ii) Learned counsel Ms. Jamboli waives service of notice on the Respondent No.2.
iii) In the event of his arrest in connection with C.R.No. 935 of 2023 registered with Dharavi Police Station, Mumbai, till the next date, the Applicant be released on bail on his executing P. R. bond in the sum of Rs.30,000/- (Rupees Thirty Thousand Only) with one or two sureties in the like amount.
iv) This order shall operate till 22/02/2024.
v) The Applicant shall cooperate with the investigation.
vi) Stand over to 22/02/2024.

(SARANG V. KOTWAL, J.)
